_comment: Recipes of the stage-2 movie studios 1-3 (rooms 24, 33, 34), prefix studio.

Studio records: 3 x 0x40 bytes at 0x458289 (studio 1, room 24), 0x4582c9 (studio 2, room 33), 0x458309 (studio 3, room 34). +0 camera slot and +0x10 lighting slot (16-byte equipment slots: +0 EQUIP.TAP index, -1 empty, +4 condition, +8 catalog field +0x64, a 1-9 rating, not the category, +0xc studio (-1 none) for sex toys), +0x20 lighting engineer, +0x24 cameraman, +0x28 director (person indices, -1 none), +0x2c director frustration, +0x30 director patience (15 - level), +0x34 movie being shot (-1 none), +0x38 shooting hours left (days * 10), +0x3c shooting running.

Movie records: 10 x 0x344 bytes at 0x455aa1, count 0x457b49: +0 title, +0x148 length in minutes, +0x14c state (1 planned, 2 in production, 3 shot), +0x158/+0x174/+0x178 recommended and chosen shooting days, +0x15c/+0x168 start and end date of shooting, +0x17c 1 = shooting paused, +0x1b0 Lula cast, +0x1b4 cast list, +0x2f4 cast count, +0x2f8/+0x2fc/+0x300 quality values written when shooting ends (0x425775).
Staff table: record i at SAVEGAME file offset 0x7b8d + 40*i, written as the pseudo address 0x45d1ad + 40*i (+0 job, +4 status: 0 free, 1 hired and idle, 2 working).

Shooting events (0x4242f2, called by 0x42408f on every timer tick of the minutes :00 and :30 while hours are left): a 6 % roll per tick; 0x45533c % 100 < 50 gives an actor problem (strings 2015-2036, 0x4848d4[i] = 1, person 0x484a10[i]), else a props wish (rand() % 24 = need, strings 2037 + 2038..2061, 0x4848d4[i] = 2) unless the sex toy store holds a toy for that need (catalog field +0x54) already given to the studio, or a free one while a props assistant (job 13) and a props manageress (job 14) work. These flags are not saved. The game logic runs once per WM_TIMER tick and stands still while DDF sheets are open, and rand() is seeded from the runner's fixed LULA_CLOCK, so a given save and start minute give the same events in every run.

studio_cast.note: prod_s2staff (all production buildings rented, one employee per job, account 1500000, 8:00, WET plot) plus one planned and cast movie, patched: movie count 1, record 0 'Studio Heat', storyline 3, category 50, scenes 0, 1, 2, 30 minutes, state 1 (planning finished), basic price 3000, cast list 527 (actor Thommy Session) and 17 (actress Cassandra Casablanca), cast count 2, and both actors in status 2 (what 'Cast actors' in the casting office writes; with status 1 the studio's actor check 0x4282af would drop them from the cast). Slow clock (0x4556bc = 30) so that the studio_ready script is not interrupted. Name and Load-dialog entry stay 'ProdAll' (300,119).

studio_ready.note: studio_cast after the game equipped studio 1 (script studio_ready.txt): in room 24 the lighting engineer Jack Zasas (164), the cameraman Charlie Eichler (230) and the director Bernie Pornolando (377) were assigned through their staff cards (studio record +0x20/+0x24/+0x28, status 2; the director's patience +0x30 = 15 - level 7 = 8), the 'Small Spotlight' (EQUIP.TAP 214, 120 $, into slot +0x10) and the 'Castor AX 80' camera (EQUIP.TAP 55, 150 $, into slot +0) were bought, then saved on the WET plot as 'Studio' in slot 4 (Load-dialog entry 300,119). Clock patched back to 8:00; the slow clock (0x4556bc = 30) stays. Slot +8 holds the catalog field +0x64 (a 1-9 rating: 3 for the camera, 4 for the spotlight), not the category.

studio_shoot.note: studio_ready after the game started shooting in studio 1 (script studio_shoot.txt, the steps of studio_shoot_start.txt): film strip -> STANDARD_LIST_BOX_DLG (0x4248dc) -> 'Studio Heat' -> START -> days sheet (0x424b50) -> 'Change filmtime' (0x424d38) -> 1 day -> thumb; then WET plot and saved as 'Shooting' in slot 4 (Load-dialog entry 300,119). The check asserts movie state 2 (+0x14c), recommended days 3 (+0x158), chosen days 1 (+0x174, +0x178), not paused (+0x17c = 0), start date 1-1-1997 (+0x15c..+0x164), studio record movie 0 (+0x34), 10 hours left (+0x38), shooting running (+0x3c = 1) and the director's frustration 1 (+0x2c, fewer days than recommended). Clock patched back to 8:00; the slow clock (0x4556bc = 30) stays.

studio_end.note: studio_shoot (movie 0 'Studio Heat' being shot in studio 1, slow clock 0x4556bc = 30) with the hours left patched to 0 (studio record +0x38 = 0x4582c1) and Lula cast in the movie (+0x1b0 = 0x455c51 = 1), clock 8:25 (the 5 game minutes to 8:30 take 155 ticks, about 10 s). At the 8:30 mark (0x42408f calls 0x4242f2 at minutes 0 and 30) the shooting ends without the random event roll (the roll needs hours left > 0): 0x425775 writes the quality values, Lula's counter 0x458371 goes up by 1, movie state 3, end date +0x168, the cast goes back to status 1 and the studio record is freed (+0x34 = -1, +0x3c = 0). Name and Load-dialog entry stay 'Shooting' (300,119).

studio_toys.note: studio_shoot (movie 0 'Studio Heat' being shot in studio 1, 10 hours left) with the stage-2 sex toy store (16-byte slots at 0x4584c1, count 0x459141; +0 EQUIP.TAP index, +4 condition, +8 catalog field +0x64, +0xc studio) patched to 24 toys, one for every props need 0-23 (catalog field +0x54: EQUIP.TAP 3, 4, 5, 2, 6, 7, ..., 25), all already assigned to studio 1 (+0xc = 0). The props branch of the shooting event roll 0x4242f2 then always finds the toy it asks for and shows nothing, so the first event is an actor problem (DREH_MSG_*, then DREH_EVENT_ACTION_DLG). Very slow clock (0x4556bc = 400: the minute 8:30 lasts 401 timer ticks, each with a 6 % roll) and clock 8:29, so that event comes within the first seconds of 8:30. Name and Load-dialog entry stay 'Shooting' (300,119).

studio_props.note: studio_shoot (movie 0 'Studio Heat' being shot in studio 1, 10 hours left, empty sex toy store, props building rented, props assistant and props manageress working) with the minute length 0x4556bc = 400, clock 8:29 and the minute countdown 0x4556c0 = 2, so the minute turns to 8:30 on the third timer tick. With the runner's fixed LULA_CLOCK the first event roll of 0x4242f2 at 8:30 then takes the props branch (0x45533c % 100 >= 50; with countdown 0 or 1 it is an actor problem) and asks for need 5 (rand() % 24): 'For the next scene, we need a powerful vibrator!'. No toy in the store, so 0x4250fd opens DREH_TOY1_DLG. Name and Load-dialog entry stay 'Shooting' (300,119).

studio_props_angry.note: studio_props with the director's frustration (studio record +0x2c = 0x4582b5) at 7 of his patience 8 (+0x30 = 15 - level 7). Declining the props wish twice (DREH_MSG_ANYWHERE_DLG toilet on the plot: 0x4242f2 adds 1 when the wish is a props one; DREH_TOY1_DLG toilet in the studio: 0x425509 adds 1) makes it 9 > 8, and the next 0x42408f tick lets him quit (string 2073, status 0, refusal counter +0x14 + 1). Name and Load-dialog entry stay 'Shooting' (300,119).

studio_props_store.note: studio_props with the sex toy store patched to 24 toys, one for every props need 0-23 (slot k holds the toy for need k: EQUIP.TAP 3, 4, 5, 2, 6, 7, ...; slot 5 is 'Arnie II Super Power', EQUIP.TAP 7, need 5), all unassigned (+0xc = -1) except slot 3 ('Super Dildo Neon', need 3), which studio 2 uses (+0xc = 1), and the props assistant 394 fired (status 0, so 0x4057d2(13) = 0 and the event roll does not hand the toy to the studio by itself). The same 8:30 event asks for the powerful vibrator; a matching free toy is in the store, so 0x4250fd opens DREH_TOY2_DLG. Name and Load-dialog entry stay 'Shooting' (300,119).

studio_idle_cast.note: studio_ready with the two cast actors 527 and 17 patched back to status 1 (hired and idle, as an actor who is in the cast but not working: planning_cast leaves them so, and training (status 3) or sickness (status 5) do the same). The studio's actor check 0x4282af, called every tick by 0x42408f for a studio with a movie, passes the cast-list index instead of the person index to 0x42568e for every cast member not in status 2; 0x42568e then finds no such person and still cuts the last entry (count - 1), so two ticks after the film is chosen the cast is empty. Name and Load-dialog entry stay 'Studio' (300,119).
